title: Basic calculator
description: Declare two numeric variables and print the result of adding, subtracting, multiplying, dividing them and getting the modulus.
hints: Remember that integer division truncates the decimals
solutionExplanation: We declare two integer variables and perform the 5 basic arithmetic operations. Integer division gives 3 (truncating 3.75), and the modulus gives 3 (the remainder of 15/4).

title: Age comparator
description: Create a program that compares two ages using comparison and logical operators. Determine if both people can vote, if at least one is over 65 years old, and if they have the same age.
hints: Use >= to compare with the minimum age
Use && to check if BOTH meet the condition
Use || to check if AT LEAST ONE meets it
solutionExplanation: We use comparison operators (>=, >, ==) to evaluate each condition, and logical operators (&&, ||) to combine them. Each result is stored in a descriptive boolean.
expectedOutput:
Person 1 can vote: true
Person 2 can vote: true
Both can vote: true
Someone over 65: true
Same age: false

title: Tax calculator with discounts
description: Calculate the final price of a product applying: base price, conditional discount (15% if buying more than 10 units, 10% if more than 5, no discount if 5 or less), 16% tax, and rounding to 2 decimals.
hints: You can nest ternary operators for the discounts
Use printf with %.2f to format to 2 decimals
The tax is calculated on the ALREADY discounted price
solutionExplanation: We use a nested ternary to determine the discount percentage based on the quantity. The tax is calculated on the already discounted price. printf with %.2f formats the decimals to 2 digits.
expectedOutput:
Unit price: $49.99
Quantity: 12
Subtotal: $599.88
Discount (15%): -$89.98
Discounted price: $509.90
Tax (16%): $81.58
Total: $591.48
